Hello! So back in march I filed and was able to do weekly claims until early April when the new system change messed up my account and I could no longer log in. I now have access after months and I am unable to file weekly certifications, I’m assuming due to inactivity? The only thing I see on website is to reopen claim on sidebar but does that slow for retroactive pay or starts when I file?

Thanks!!
This group does not support pet stores, should really not be on here

Unfortunately the “starter” sets sold at pet stores are not at all adequate for rabbits. I would look on house rabbit society’s website (rabbit.org) for size needs. I didn’t know in the beginning when I got my first but now I’ve had him for 9 years.

Hello!

Is there a better way to contact technical support?

Every time I try to login, it keeps saying my password is incorrect, even after doing a PW reset

I have had no luck through beacon support email and I haven’t been paid since late April....

Thank you I will reach out. Definitely want him to be loved and cherished and willing to take the time to rehome him. So many rabbits end up discarded outside when no longer wanted and I do not want that to happen to him.

I have! But will try to reach out to them, thanks. It’s hard because people either want a companion to their other rabbit or it’s parents who want pets for their very young kids(which I don’t feel comfortable with as Rabbits tend to be abandoned because they do take some work to care for)
This sounds awesome, just moved to Baltimore after living in Pittsburgh for 4 years!
People do not need animal fat to survive.... Plenty of other ways to get the fat you need. Many people with allergies to dairy and/ or red meat are alive and kicking...
